annotations.title: Start watching a site, with no account, key or email

description: Wraps POST /start. Start watching a site, with no account, key or email. Starts checking a site's homepage now, for someone who has no account yet, and answers a private results link and a claim link for the person the agent works for. A site already being watched answers already_watching with new links to the same checks. No one is alerted until a person claims it. A site whose owner asked us not to look, or whose robots.txt names site-monitor, isn't started. Needs no key.

url.description: The site's address or domain: example.com

name: start

alerts_enabled.description: Always false until a person claims the site: no one is alerted

claim.description: The claim link, for the person the agent works for: signing in from it adds the site to their team, with its history only if the team has verified the domain

claim_expires_at.description: When the claim link stops working; renew it with POST /start/s/{token}/claim (ISO 8601, UTC)

interval_seconds.description: How often the homepage is checked, in seconds: every 30 minutes at first, once a day after 30 days unclaimed

last_checked_at.description: The newest check, or null before the first (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

message.description: What happened and what to do with each link, in words

next_check_at.description: When the next check is due (the newest plus the interval), or null before the first (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

next_steps.description: The calls that usually come next

outcome.description: started: a new monitor (201); already_watching: someone started this site before, and these are new links to the same checks (200)

results.description: The results link, for the agent only: keep it private

status.description: Always watching: the site's homepage is being checked

watching_since.description: When it was first started (ISO 8601, UTC)

title: Start watching a site, with no account, key or email
